raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: The figure is a line chart titled "Sparsity Ratio of SDPA Output, Threshold 1e-2", illustrating the sparsity ratio across different layers of a model. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and ranges from 0 to approximately 22, with numerical tick marks at intervals of 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). The y-axis is labeled "Sparsity Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The chart contains three distinct data series, each represented by a different line style and color, as indicated in the legend located in the upper right corner. The first series, labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", is depicted as a dashed blue line. It starts at approximately 0.18 at Layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.05 by Layer 2, and then remains nearly flat, hovering near 0.03 for the rest of the layers, ending slightly below 0.02 at Layer 22. The second series, labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", is shown as a dotted orange line. It begins at 1.0 at Layer 0, decreases steeply to around 0.45 by Layer 5, continues to decline more gradually to approximately 0.20 by Layer 15, and then exhibits fluctuations, rising to about 0.40 at Layer 21 before dropping again to around 0.35 at Layer 22. The third series, labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", is represented by a dash-dotted green line. It starts at 1.0 at Layer 0, decreases sharply to about 0.85 by Layer 2, continues to decline to approximately 0.35 by Layer 10, then drops further to around 0.15 by Layer 15, and remains relatively stable with minor fluctuations, ending near 0.05 at Layer 22. All three lines originate at a sparsity ratio of 1.0 at Layer 0, but diverge rapidly thereafter, with the blue line remaining low, the orange line showing higher and more variable values, and the green line exhibiting intermediate behavior.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: This line chart displays the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three conditions: before the gate, after the gate, and after an average gate. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to approximately 22 with a linear scale and uniform numerical increments of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with a linear scale and uniform increments of 0.2. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line with no markers representing "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03," which starts at approximately 0.18 at Layer 0, drops to around 0.05 by Layer 5, and remains near 0.02 for the rest of the layers; an orange dotted line with no markers representing "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44," which begins at 1.0 at Layer 0, decreases to about 0.45 by Layer 5, then fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.4 from Layer 10 to Layer 22; and a green dash-dotted line with no markers representing "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33," which starts at 1.0 at Layer 0, declines to approximately 0.35 by Layer 5, continues to decrease to about 0.12 by Layer 15, and then fluctuates between 0.05 and 0.15 for the remaining layers. The legend is located in the upper right corner, indicating the average sparsity ratio for each condition.
raw_responses.English:
The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three conditions: sparsity before gating, after gating, and after average gating. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to approximately 22, with linear scaling and integer tick labels at regular intervals. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Three lines are plotted: a blue dashed line with no markers for "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03", which starts at approximately 0.18 at layer 0 and decreases to near 0.0 by layer 22; an orange dotted line with no markers for "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44", which starts at 1.0 at layer 0, drops to around 0.45 by layer 5, fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.45 through layer 22, and ends near 0.35; and a green dash-dotted line with no markers for "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33", which starts at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to approximately 0.35 by layer 5, continues to decline to around 0.1 by layer 15, and stabilizes near 0.05 by layer 22. The lines show distinct trends, with the blue line remaining consistently low, the orange line exhibiting more variability, and the green line showing a smoother decline.

DESCRIPTION: The plot shows the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across layers (x-axis, 0 to ~22, linear) for three conditions: before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.03, starts at ~0.18 and drops to ~0.0), after gate (orange dotted line, avg 0.44, starts at 1.0, drops to ~0.45 by layer 5, fluctuates between 0.2 and 0.45, ends near 0.35), and after average gate (green dash-dotted line, avg 0.33, starts at 1.0, drops to ~0.35 by layer 5, continues to ~0.1 by layer 15, stabilizes near 0.05 by layer 22). The y-axis is sparsity ratio (0.0 to 1.0, linear).
